summary: Frontend-only regression + new booking flow tested end-to-end on Alfred (EaseMyTrip scripted chat). All 28 scripted-flow assertions passed: happy path booking (dates→budget→hotel→cost→dates-confirm→traveller-form→contact-form→seat→success→download), traveller-form validation, post-booking support/email-correction/cab-offer/closing, modify loop (booking-chip-modify → modify-chip-hotel re-shows hotel cards), and itinerary regression (inspire-me → carousel → destination → duration chip → summary → editor modal). Prices verified: flight ₹8,640 live price, total ₹38,040 for Tropicana, contact prefilled (98450-12345 / nancy.tanwar@gmail.com), autofill note visible, toll-free 1800-419-4646 present.
critical_code_review_comments: src/App.js is ~716 lines and centralises every scripted flow; consider splitting booking/support/itinerary handlers into hooks or a small state machine to keep it under the 700-line threshold and improve maintainability.

BookingForm keeps a single local error state shared across traveller/contact steps; using two testids (booking-form-error and booking-contact-error) works today but the render branches early on step==='traveller', so the contact error path is fine — just document this to avoid future confusion.

handleSend routes 'update/modify/change/wrong/email/edit' regex to support only when stage==='booked'; typing any of these words during earlier stages silently falls to fallbackReply. Acceptable for scripted demo but worth a comment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat input uses data-testid='chat-input-field' and send button 'chat-send-button'. All booking testids verified working. Alfred replies use setTimeout 0.7-2.4s — waits of 1.5-2s between steps are sufficient. Traveller form name/age default to empty (validates on empty submit); contact form phone/email are prefilled. Modify-hotel returns to booking-options stage with fresh hotel cards. Regression: itinerary flow (inspire-me → destination-card → duration-chip → summary → Open) still fully functional.
